title: Closing thanks
summary: Redd thanks Blakeney and addresses future listeners.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Mr. Blakeney, needless to say, this has been a wonderful experience for me. Perhaps I did say it once, and we could go on and on and on; your memories are so vivid of all of your travels and all of your contacts with all kinds of people, you shared so willingly with me in this interview.
Your contribution to our great American artform, jazz, are immeasureable. I want to thank you for the many, many years you've given a sincere effort to perpetuate this music.
To those of you that will be listening to this interview throughout the years, I certainly hope that you will enjoy listening to it as much as I did enjoy interviewing Mr. Andrew Blakeney.
